reports.title: Hemab Therapeutics Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides

desk.headline: Net loss widens to $27.3m as R&D rises; pivotal Phase 3 SOLARA trial started; cash of $430.2m funds operations into 2029

numbers.eps_basis: GAAP basic and diluted net loss per share

results: No product revenue (clinical-stage company); net loss grew to $27.3m from $17.1m as R&D rose to $24.6m from $14.6m.
Loss per share fell to $0.58 from $18.04 only because the share count rose sharply after the May 2026 IPO.
Cash and investments fell $27.3m in the quarter to $430.2m; operating cash use was $72.5m over nine months.
Started SOLARA, a Phase 3 trial of once-weekly sutacimig in Glanzmann thrombasthenia; the FDA suggested a randomised design but Hemab chose single-arm.
First data in Factor VII deficiency showed clotting time shortened by over 50% in both patients; first volunteer dosed with HMB-003 for heavy menstrual bleeding.

guidance.summary: No financial guidance beyond cash runway: Hemab says its cash should fund operations into 2029, the same runway it gave in August.

watch: Updated sutacimig and HMB-003 data at the ASH meeting on 13–14 December 2026.
First patients entering SOLARA's run-in in Q4 2026, and any FDA pushback on the single-arm design.
HMB-002 von Willebrand data at EAHAD in February 2027.

sources.title: Hemab Therapeutics Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results — Earnings Whispers, 11 Aug 2026
